arguments.where_clause: amount_usd_cents > 100000 AND card_id IN (SELECT id FROM cards WHERE card_type = 'Debit')
arguments.explanation: Flags transactions over $1,000 made on debit cards. The application will measure this rule against the fraud labels. A month-by-month breakdown is not part of this proposal and can be requested as a separate question.
assumptions: 'Over $1,000' means amount_usd_cents strictly greater than 100000 (i.e. more than $1,000.00).
Negative amounts are not excluded; they fail the over-$1,000 test anyway.
The monthly breakdown was not produced by this tool call; it would need a separate query.
